nb.customAccent.editingExisting: Jūs keičiate egzistuojančia akcentą kuris pavadintas "{name}"
nb.customAccent.editingNew: Naujas akcentas bus padarytas su pavadinimu "{name}"
nb.customAccent.title: Akcentų Tvarkylė
nb.editorSettings.blockColorsHelp: Customize the primary color of each block category.
nb.editorSettings.canvasSizeMultiplierHe: How large the canvas is in the paint editor relative to the stage.
nb.editorSettings.compactTabsHelp: Removes the text from tabs, leaving just the icon.
nb.editorSettings.cornerSizeHelp: Controls how rounded the corners of blocks are.
nb.editorSettings.customBlockShapeHelp: Adjust the padding, corner radius, notch height, and field height of blocks.
nb.editorSettings.darkModeHelp: Padarys puslapį tamsiai kad padarytumė lengviau akims.
nb.editorSettings.dirty: Perjunk puslapį kad galėtum pradėti naudoti naujus nustatymus
nb.editorSettings.disableCompilerHelp: Disables the {APP_NAME} compiler by default. It can still be manually enabled per-project through Edit > Advanced Settings.
nb.editorSettings.disableInspectBlockHel: Removes the Inspect Block item from the right-click context menu on blocks.
nb.editorSettings.enableDebuggerHelp: Enables a debugger panel and extension that allows you to inspect logs and monitor performance. The debugger contains the most functionality with the compiler disabled.
nb.editorSettings.encodingBitRateHelp: Defines the bit rate for sounds encoded in NitroBolt.
nb.editorSettings.fieldHeightHelp: Controls the height of text inputs and dropdowns inside blocks, independent of overall padding.
nb.editorSettings.hiddenCategoriesHelp: Choose which default categories to show or hide in the block toolbox.
nb.editorSettings.hideBackpackHelp: Removes the backpack from the bottom of the screen.
nb.editorSettings.hideFeedbackHelp: Removes the feedback button from the top of the screen.
nb.editorSettings.hidePauseHelp: Removes the pause button from the project controls.
nb.editorSettings.labelContrastThreshold: Sets how bright a block color must be before its text label switches to dark for readability. Lower values use dark text less often, higher values use dark text more often.
nb.editorSettings.maxCornerRadiusHelp: Sets an upper limit on the corner radius as a multiple of the base corner size, used by round output blocks.
nb.editorSettings.noCutButtonHelp: Hides the cut to clipboard button.
nb.editorSettings.noSwapButtonHelp: Hides the fill and outline swap button.
nb.editorSettings.notchSizeHelp: Controls how tall the notches and bumps that let blocks snap together are.
nb.editorSettings.nudgeMultiplierHelp: How far selected objects move when pressing Shift+Arrow keys in the paint editor.
nb.editorSettings.paddingSizeHelp: Controls the overall size and spacing of blocks.
nb.editorSettings.stageLeftHelp: Swaps the stage and the block palette.
nb.editorSettings.title: Editor Settings
nb.editorSettings.unrestrictUnsandboxed: Allow all extensions to load unsandboxed
nb.editorSettings.unrestrictUnsandboxedH: Išjungia išplėtimų sauga ir nenaudos smėliadėžė, ir išplėtimų importą, URL parametrų išplėtimus, ir projekto išplėtimus. Yra pavojinga ir turi būti naudojama tik jeigu jūs visiškai pasitiki visus išplėtimus.
nb.editorSettings.username.mustChange: Sorry, the cloud variable server thinks your username may be unsafe. Please change it to something else or {resetIt}.
nb.editorSettings.usernameHelp: This value will be stored in your browser's storage. It may be logged when you interact with projects that contain cloud variables. It will also be used for Live Collaboration.
nb.editorSettings.usernameHelp2: Values that do not correspond to a valid Scratch account will typically be rejected by the cloud variable server. We recommend leaving it as-is or changing it to your Scratch username.
nb.editorSettings.vanillaPaletteHelp: Hides NitroBolt-exclusive blocks (e.g. extended operators, switch, for-each-in-range, etc.) and hides the JSON and assets categories.
nb.editorSettings.versionControl.default: The initial branch name used when creating a new Git repository. Existing repositories are not affected.
nb.editorSettings.viewCounterHelp: Kai jūs pradedate projektą kuris pakrautas iš „Scratch“, bus įrašytą kad peržiūrėjimų skaičius padidės per laiką. Peržiūrėjimai yra anoniminiai ir negalima gauti atgal naudotoją.
nb.editorSettings.visibleTabsHelp: Choose which tabs to show in the editor. Hidden tabs can still be accessed via keyboard shortcuts.
nb.editorSettings.waveformColorHelp: If checked, waveforms will display a volume gradient where green is quieter and red is louder.
nb.editorSettings.waveformRenderTypeHelp: Choose between sharp edges on sound waveforms or soft edges like in Scratch. Sharp edges can offer more detail on large sounds.
nb.extensionManager.title: Extension Manager
nb.git.desktopOnly: Git is only available in NitroBolt Desktop.
nb.git.missing: Git is not installed or could not be found.
nb.git.title: Source Control
